_classes.name: sunset extension of an earlier chapter stored with zero records (unnamed-holder extensions still silent after re-ask)
_classes.rule: law key in signed with no row in duties/powers/dropped, act_clause matches 'AN ACT to amend chapter \d+ of the laws of', and packet LAW TEXT matches (expire|deemed repealed|remain in full force).{0,200}\[[^\]]{0,40}\]\s*\{\{ (law-level rule; counts laws, not records)

_classes.name: conforming cross-reference or defined-term change that widens the class of an existing court/probation duty not extracted
_classes.rule: none mechanical: needs a reading of whether a renamed term or added subdivision list widens an unchanged duty sentence

_classes.name: conditional duty ('If the department determines...') given deadline on_effective_date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and the packet text between the start of the quote's sentence and the quote contains If/if/In the event/Upon/When (or the quote starts with one)

_classes.name: fixed_date effective date earlier than the signing date with no retroactivity clause
_classes.rule: effective_dates[k].rule=='fixed_date' and effective_date < signed[k].signed_date and not retroactive_to (law-level; records carrying the date counted too)

_classes.name: agency duty to prescribe application forms dropped as benefit_entitlement
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='benefit_entitlement' and quote matches /prescribed by the (department|commissioner|superintendent|board|office|division)/i

2017-A2805-01.quote: The department shall establish and support, within available appropriations, entrepreneurship assistance centers at career education agencies and not-for-profit corporations including, but not limited to, local development corporations, chambers of commerce, community-based business outreach centers and other community-based organizations.

2017-A2805-02.quote: The department shall establish criteria for selection and designation of such centers which shall include, but not be limited to:

2017-A2805-05.quote: Monitor the performance of each entrepreneurial assistance center and require quarterly and annual reports from each entrepreneurial assistance center at such time and in such a manner as prescribed by the commissioner.

2017-A2805-06.quote: Evaluate the entrepreneurial assistance centers established under this article and report quarterly and annually, on or before January first, two thousand eighteen, and on or before each January first thereafter, and submit the results of such evaluation to the governor and the legislature.

2017-A2805-07.quote: Such reports shall be made available to the public on the department's website.

2017-A2805-08.quote: Submit to the director of the division of the budget, the chairperson of the senate finance committee and the chairperson of the assembly ways and means committee an evaluation of the effectiveness of the programs established under this article prepared by an entity independent of the department.

2017-A2805-09.quote: Between evaluation due dates, maintain the necessary records and data required to satisfy such evaluation requirements and to satisfy information requests received from the director of the budget, the chairperson of the senate finance committee and the chairperson of the assembly ways and means committee between such evaluation due dates.
